start_command: cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 & cd frontend && npm run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
seed_command: python -m app.tests.synthetic_data ../example_data/synthetic (regenerate the artificial demo dataset; cwd backend)
prohibited_actions: no identifiable patient data — only artificial synthetic fixtures are ever loaded (CRITICAL)
no diagnostic, clinical, or therapeutic claims
no loading of the gitignored real omics data (the ~79MB real_data/ is never touched)
no npm run lint (hangs on interactive ESLint setup) — never invoked anywhere

coverage.feature: Frontend landing loads and identifies the app
Backend FastAPI is reachable and identifies itself

coverage.unautomated_reason: requires a completed analysis run seeded from synthetic fixtures; pending an authenticated seeded-run journey
needs synthetic GTEx/HPA/UniProt fixtures uploaded and an async job polled (/analyze/async -> /jobs/{id}); pending a fixture-upload harness
PROHIBITED — no identifiable patient data and no diagnostic claims; the gitignored real_data is never loaded

journeys.name: Frontend landing loads and identifies the pipeline
journeys.user_impact: If the landing page does not load, no researcher can start an analysis.

journeys.name: Research-triage-only framing is visible
journeys.user_impact: If the research-only framing disappears, output could be misread as clinical guidance.

journeys.name: FastAPI backend is reachable and self-identifies
journeys.user_impact: If the FastAPI backend is down, the frontend proxy has nothing to call and no analysis can run.
